items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: And Billy Price used to use that.

ctx.x: Well they had a lot of numbers around here years ago, if they claim was never, uh, risky. You might have heard one of them was hot nuts. You ever hear hot nuts? Hot peanuts. I've heard of it.
And Billy Price used to use that. I've heard of it.
Then he had another one called Nice Boy. That other? Nice Boy. He had a fellow like Billy Miller around here years ago, that featured sweet violets.
